刚接触触摸板后，暂缓滑动反馈多久。调大更能避开按压准备动作，调小滑动反馈来得更快: Delay sliding feedback after first touching the pad. A longer delay filters preparation for a click; a shorter delay responds sooner. Only affects Steamless haptic rules, not pointer movement.
点击松开后，暂停滑动反馈多久。调大可减少松开后的杂震，调小更快恢复滑动反馈。不会: Pause sliding feedback after releasing a click. A longer pause reduces stray feedback; a shorter pause resumes sooner. Does not delay release feedback or pointer movement.
压力高于此值时不触发滑动震动，避免按压时混入滑动点振。调低更保守，调高允许较重的: Suppress sliding haptics above this pressure to avoid mixing slide ticks into clicks. Lower values are more conservative; higher values allow firmer sliding. This is not the mouse press threshold.
每个脉冲通电多久，单位微秒（1000 μs = 1 ms）。调大通常更明显、更厚: How long each pulse is powered, in microseconds (1000 μs = 1 ms). Longer tends to feel fuller; shorter feels lighter. This is not tone frequency. Start with small changes near the recorded value.
同一次反馈中，相邻脉冲之间暂停多久。调大会让脉冲更分离；0 表示紧接着发送。重复: Pause between pulses in one feedback event. Larger values separate pulses; 0 sends them consecutively. With a count of 1, this has no effect and does not set the interval between slide events.
一次触发包含几个脉冲。1 是单次短促反馈；调大通常更持续、更像一串震动。通电与关: Pulses per trigger. 1 gives a single short tick; more produces a longer burst. Total on/off time multiplied by count must stay within 80 ms.
两次滑动反馈至少相隔多久。调小可能更密，调大更稀疏。还必须达到触发距离，因此不是: Minimum time between slide feedback events. Shorter allows denser feedback; longer spaces it out. The distance threshold must also be reached. This is not a periodic timer and affects only sliding feedback.
手指持续滑动累计多远才允许下一次反馈。调小更容易、更频繁触发；调大需要滑得更远。: Accumulated finger movement required for another feedback event. Smaller values trigger more often. These px use a fixed input scale, independent of pointer speed, and are not actual screen pixels. The minimum interval also applies.
短音调每秒振动的次数。改变震动质感，不代表强弱：更高的 Hz 不一定更强，也可能: Tone cycles per second. Changes texture, not simply strength: higher Hz may be harder to feel. Tune together with duration and gain.
一次短音调持续多久。调大更持久，调小更利落；最长 80 ms。与滑动反馈之间的间: Duration of one tone, up to 80 ms. Longer lasts longer; shorter feels sharper. This is separate from the interval between slide events.
内置反馈或音调的增益。越接近 0 越强，例如 -3 dB 比 -12 dB 强；: Gain for built-in feedback or tones. Closer to 0 is stronger: -3 dB is stronger than -12 dB. Allowed range is -30 to 0 dB. The effect type also influences feel.
1 为内置点振，2 为内置点击，是手柄固件提供的两种效果。数字表示类型，不表示强: 1 is the firmware tick effect; 2 is the firmware click effect. The number selects a type, not strength. Adjust strength with gain in dB.
手指移动相同距离时，鼠标移动多少。调大移动更快、更远，调小更精细。仅对“移动鼠标: Pointer movement for the same finger travel. Higher moves faster and farther; lower gives finer control. Only affects Move pointer, not scrolling.
鼠标移动的平滑程度。调大可以减少抖动，但跟手性可能降低；调小反应更直接。0 为关: Pointer smoothing. Higher can reduce jitter but add lag; lower responds more directly. 0 disables smoothing.
每滚动一格需要累计的触摸板位移。越小滚动越快，越大滚动越慢。只影响“滚动内容”动: Trackpad travel required for one wheel step. Lower scrolls faster; higher scrolls slower. Only affects Scroll content, not pointer movement.
压力达到这个阈值后视为按下。调低更容易触发，也更容易误触；调高需要更用力。此数值: Pressure required to register a press. Lower is easier to trigger but more prone to accidental clicks; higher requires more pressure. This is a sensor reading, not grams.
按下后，压力低于此值才视为松开。必须低于按下力度；差距较大可减少边界抖动，但需要: After a press, pressure must fall below this value to release. Must be lower than the press threshold. A wider gap reduces boundary jitter but requires a fuller release.
轨迹球模式中，手指离开后鼠标滑行的减速程度。调大停得更快，调小滑得更远。仅在启用: How quickly trackball movement slows after lifting your finger. Higher stops sooner; lower glides farther. Only affects pointer movement with trackball inertia enabled.
滑动反馈：手指持续移动时触发。按压反馈：触摸板按下时触发。Steamless 规: Slide feedback triggers during movement. Press feedback triggers on pad press; Steamless rules use confirmed hardware clicks, while legacy rules follow pressure thresholds. Release feedback triggers on release. All three can be configured independently.

不签：Talaria 可以操作普通窗口，不能操作管理员窗口。: Without signing: Talaria controls ordinary windows, but cannot control administrator windows.
签了：在此电脑生成代码签名证书并加入本机根证书信任库，允许 Talaria 通过: With signing: create a code-signing certificate on this PC, trust it in the machine root store, and use UIAccess to control administrator windows. Steam can remain unelevated.
风险：新增的证书信任对本机所有用户生效；若程序或输入流程被滥用，可能影响管理员程: Risk: this trust applies to all users of this PC. Abuse of the app or input path could affect administrator programs. Self-signing does not establish a public publisher identity or guarantee removal of security warnings.
私钥正常完成后会删除，不导出、不上传。证书一年到期；升级前还原，卸载时移除本项目: The private key is deleted after normal completion, never exported or uploaded. The certificate lasts one year. Upgrades restore the old files first; uninstall removes this certificate. Manual revocation is also available. UAC and Secure Boot are unchanged.

以后可重新运行 install.exe，勾选以启用，取消勾选以撤销；个人配置保留: Run install.exe again to enable or deselect it to revoke signing. Your profiles are retained.
